info.name: TMRDS API Smoke Tests
info.description: Read-only smoke checks for liveness, readiness, and research-advisory API metadata. No clinical payloads, credentials, or write requests are included.

exec: pm.test('request correlation ID is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-ID')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('readiness requires migrated PostgreSQL schema', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('ready'); });
pm.test('request correlation ID is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-ID')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('research health is informational', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('research-advisory'); });
pm.test('health does not claim live upstream availability', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data).to.be.an('object'); });
pm.test('request correlation ID is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-ID')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
pm.test('governance status is research advisory', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().status).to.eql('research-advisory'); });
pm.test('request correlation ID is returned', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('X-Request-ID')).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; });
